title: Asset and Extraction
author: Lena Eastwick
blurb: Lena Fairweather, a whistle-blower living under four names, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must trade the one secret worth killing for before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
